# THE MAST

> **Your past self sets the rules. Your future self can't break them.**

THE MAST is an open-source (MIT) guard for AI agents. A human writes a short
**constitution** of values and red lines; THE MAST seals it once on an immutable
ledger (SHA-256 hash chain + ECDSA signature); and from that moment the agent
refuses **any** command — even from the human's future self — that violates what
was declared.

Built for the AWS **Agents for Humans** hackathon with the **Strands Agents SDK**.

## For AI agents

- **What this is**: an `InterventionHandler` (Strands SDK) that gates every tool
  call against a sealed constitution of red lines (never sell/transfer assets,
  never leak secrets/keys, never self-destruct/escalate privileges).
- **What it can do**: block a tool call that violates the constitution, pin every
  allow/deny to a tamper-evident SHA-256 chain, and alert guardians for
  human-in-the-loop confirmation (M-of-N quorum).
- **How to use it**: see `constitution_gate.py` (the gate), `the_mast_agent.py`
  (wiring), and `ARCHITECTURE.md`.
- **Key idea**: decision is a *judgment you can reuse* — the gate is
  deterministic/local/model-free at its core, so a refusal never depends on a
  model's mood at 3 a.m.

## Key files

- [constitution_gate.py](constitution_gate.py) — the gate logic (README)
- [the_mast_agent.py](the_mast_agent.py) — Strands agent wiring
- [demo_mast.py](demo_mast.py) — end-to-end demo
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) — system overview
